description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'ElevationDragFragment' that manages a UI with draggable and z-elevated view elements, including outline customization, elevation adjustments, and drag interactions.

classes.name: ElevationDragFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages a draggable circular view with adjustable elevation and custom outline shape.

classes.name: ElevationDragFragment.CircleOutlineProvider
classes.description: Inner class extending ViewOutlineProvider to define oval outline for the view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes outline provider and elevation step size.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, sets up the draggable view, outline provider, and button click listeners for adjusting elevation.

methods.name: CircleOutlineProvider.getOutline
methods.description: Defines the outline of the view as an oval fitting the view bounds.
